sources.note: TouchWorks EHR product page. Describes it as built for large ambulatory practices, highlights clinical, operational, and wellness solutions. Sparse on detailed feature lists but confirms target market.
Full Altera product portfolio page. Lists Sunrise, Paragon, TouchWorks, dbMotion, Care Director, CareFX, Altera Context, and Ventus. Helps understand where TouchWorks fits in the ecosystem.
Company history page. Confirms Altera was formed from Allscripts Hospitals & Large Physician Practices segment, acquired by Harris/Constellation Software in 2022.
ONC regulatory compliance page. Page rendered mostly empty (JS-heavy), minimal useful content retrieved.

Providers Management, Inc. about page. Lists their ONC-certified Integrated Providers Patient Portal (v3.18) with TouchWorks EHR as required additional software. Confirms Burton, MI address and Genesys PHO affiliation.
Genesys PHO website. Confirms it is a physician-hospital organization with ~100 PCPs and several hundred specialists, affiliated with Ascension Genesys Hospital in Michigan.
G2 reviews for TouchWorks. 4.0/5.0 rating. Users praise centralized access to schedules and charts; criticize UI intuitiveness and multiple clicks for common tasks.
KLAS user comments for TouchWorks EHR. Mixed feedback — some clients note vendor is 'behind and playing catch-up' post-Allscripts separation. Training cited as weakness.
Becker's article on KLAS ambulatory EHR rankings. TouchWorks scored 6.8/9, trailing Epic (7.5) and athenahealth (7.1).
Software Finder profile. Confirms centralizing orders, lab results, radiology reports in a single database. Notes customization can be difficult for new users.
TouchWorks user reviews. Highlights issues with progress note searchability and support responsiveness.
Elion Health product profile. Confirms features and integrations for TouchWorks EHR.
Definitive Healthcare ambulatory EHR market share data. Veradigm/Allscripts/Altera holds ~3-3.6% market share.
News coverage of Allscripts-to-Altera rebranding following Harris Computer acquisition in May 2022.
Constellation Software press release on Harris acquiring Allscripts segment for ~$700M.
TouchWorks EHR 2025.4 release notes. Details new features: direct faxing, enhanced attachments, smart pharmacy/lab choices, USCDI v3, C-CDA R4.1 support, AI dictation.
Press release about TouchWorks Note+ ambient listening and AI note generation feature.
6sense market share data for Altera Digital Health in EHR segment.
SelectHub TouchWorks profile. Confirms features for large ambulatory groups and multi-specialty environments.
